A little about me

The girl behind the lens.

Hi, I'm Aizelle Mynina A. Pitargue, but you can call me Zelle. I'm a Computer Science student at CCC with a passion for photography. I love capturing soft, graceful moments and turning them into images that feel calm, elegant, and free. Studying technology while creating art lets me see the world through both logic and creativity.
